implementation_status: IMPLEMENTED; native production render intentionally NOT_RUN

usage.design_override: Optional --design <parent-prepared-design.json>. Fonts always resolve to this worktree's bundled app fonts. No other locale is accepted.

exit_codes.0: Selected scope PASS; --check-layout/self-test do not certify native sources

usage.write_policy: Checks/preflight create no files. Full render creates only the explicit NEW output directory after source/crop/font/composition pixel gates pass. Existing output directories are rejected, even if empty. No overwriting, automatic deletion, downloads, fallback capture search, Git operations, Actions, browser or publication. A later disk/encoding failure may leave a partial directory without a completion manifest; retain it and select a new output path.

parent_provenance_interface.format: Parent-standard snake_case, not an alternate renderer-owned provenance file. Complete machine-readable JSON Schema is printed by --print-provenance-schema. Additional actual CI/test/device metadata is allowed and retained.
parent_provenance_interface.identity: commit must exactly equal the independently supplied full lowercase 40-hex --expected-commit; workflow_run is a positive numeric STRING exactly matching --expected-workflow-run. workflow_url must identify that same GitHub run, and optionally equal --expected-workflow-url. The fresh tested capture commit is independent from base_commit and is NOT forced to equal the base SHA.

outputs_record_required.sha256: literal lowercase 64-hex hash of original file bytes

branding_record_required.sha256: literal lowercase 64-hex hash of original native-component PNG

parent_provenance_interface.branding_pixels: Actual transparent RGBA VaultDialWordmark, lightForeground for the light marketing surface, including mechanical-wheel Q and tail. The renderer only trims its native transparent alpha bounds, contains without upscaling and composites original pixels. No wordmark typesetting, Q drawing or reuse of old manually rendered branding.
parent_provenance_interface.required_source_count_detail: Twelve canonical screenshot PNGs plus one transparent native wordmark; optional vault-locked capture adds one only when its inset is enabled. Extra captures in the parent's artifact/provenance are never substituted.
parent_provenance_interface.checks: Every required file must exist inside the artifact root with matching SHA, dimensions, mode and true opacity. Reject path traversal, symlink escapes, duplicate JSON keys/records, blank screenshots, rotated EXIF, wrong locale/run/commit/device, failed/skipped tests or missing source/crop approval. Actual CI identity/test authenticity and semantic source QA remain independently verified by the parent, not inferred from an unsigned JSON claim.

parent_design_fields_after_source_vision.sourceVisualQA: Set approved=true, provenanceSHA256=hash of the exact capture_provenance.json bytes, commit, workflowRun, reviewer and nonempty notes. Confirm nativeWordmarkComponent=VaultDialWordmark, nativeWordmarkForeground=lightForeground and nativeStatusBar 9:41/fullBattery/dynamicIsland/dark. Initial approval is deliberately false.
parent_design_fields_after_source_vision.slots_primarySourceSHA256: For all ten slots, bind primarySourceSHA256 to the actual original primary source hash.
parent_design_fields_after_source_vision.slots_primaryProtectedRects: For all ten slots, replace null with at least one [left,top,right,bottom] source-pixel rectangle covering the primary proof that must remain visible. Include all essential claim evidence/buttons. Status-bar source rect [0,0,1206,200] is additionally protected automatically. Insets AND their shadow envelopes must not overlap mapped protected evidence.
parent_design_fields_after_source_vision.insets: For each enabled inset, replace crop=null with the actual QA-approved integer original-source rectangle and cropSourceSHA256=null with its exact original source hash. Required inset IDs: large-file-results, native-system-confirmation, again-in-two-days, real-analysis-results. Crop the whole native evidence, never reconstruct controls/text. Inset crop top must be >=200 to exclude a second native status bar/Dynamic Island. No native pixel is upscaled.
parent_design_fields_after_source_vision.optional_lock: Optional native locked-vault inset is disabled, never a fallback. Enable only with its fresh capture/provenance entry and approved SHA-bound crop.
parent_design_fields_after_source_vision.target_boxes: Parent may reposition/resize a native inset's targetBox after actual source QA if needed to preserve primary evidence and complete dialog/pill content. Shared headline/subtitle/logo containers, 70 px margins and the common full-phone frame/size/position remain unchanged.

layout_contract.surface: Continuous very soft ice-blue #E0EFF9 -> #EAF4FB smoothstep gradient; black app-ink, left-aligned Sentence case copy. No horizon through the phone, centered SaaS hero, slogan, slide numerals or invented result/award/user-count overlays.
layout_contract.fonts: Bundled PMDisplay-Bold (Bricolage) and PMText-Medium/Bold (Figtree), never fallback/system approximations.
layout_contract.type_rule: Measure actual glyph bboxes. Try all allowed word-boundary wraps at preferred size, then decrement by 1 px; headline/subtitle <=2 lines, no truncation/copy rewrite/stretch. Headline preferred 112 px/floor 84 px, subtitles preferred 52 px/floor 46 px. If no layout fits at the floor: BLOCKED.
layout_contract.gesture_overlay: Only slide 1: large marketing Keep-up #1B6FA8, Trash-left #C4441A, Later-right #6347D0 arrows and labels outside the native phone. Physical gesture semantics are never mirrored.
layout_contract.future_localization: Only en-US now. Long-language/RTL layout and shaping rules are documented in design.json localizationRule; no translated assets are generated.

color_and_pixel_proof.native_inputs: Opaque native RGB/RGBA may carry sRGB or Display P3/other valid RGB ICC. Preserve original file hashes and ICC. Tagged inputs are normalized with Pillow ImageCms/LittleCMS, relative-colorimetric intent, flags=0, to an embedded sRGB profile BEFORE original crop/resampling. Native alpha is preserved. Untagged RGB is explicitly interpreted as sRGB; parent must confirm that assumption, not silently strip a P3 tag upstream.
color_and_pixel_proof.per_layer_manifest: Original source/SHA/mode/ICC, normalized pixel-buffer SHA and transform metadata, exact original crop, target geometry, nominal/effective native scale, one known LANCZOS resample, mask SHA, actual compared/occluded pixel counts and zero-difference masked source/output SHAs. Exact comparison runs before export and again on reopened lossless PNGs.
color_and_pixel_proof.comparison_scope: Compare every visible, fully opaque native interior against the defined ICC-normalized known resample. Only outer 4x-antialiased rounded-mask edges and explicitly counted later inset/shadow occlusions are excluded. Native transparent wordmark pixels are compared against the exact original-alpha composite. At least 50% of the phone's opaque interior remains directly comparable; focal insets compare all their opaque interior. Protected primary evidence may not be occluded.
color_and_pixel_proof.truth_limit: These checks prove rendering fidelity, not the factual meaning/content of a screenshot; parent source vision QA must verify real dupe/large-file/blur results, measured sizes, entire OS dialog/pill, months population, rights/no real people or third-party branding, and no unsupported claims.

planned_exports_after_parent_gates.pngs: Exactly 01-...png through 10-...png, en-US only, 1206x2622 RGB/no alpha, embedded sRGB ICC; no existing images copied or replaced.

search_preview.meaning: Logical-phone search-row scale, no fabricated Store chrome

planned_exports_after_parent_gates.manifest: render-manifest.json records source, renderer/design/font/output hashes, every native layer/crop/scale/ICC/pixel proof, text lines/sizes/glyph bboxes and common-layout QA. Human final visual acceptance remains NOT_RUN until parent inspects actual exports.

self_test.scope: Memory-only rectangles, actual bundled-font layout, provenance-contract/failure injections, RGB/sRGB PNG+JPEG encoding, ICC normalization/alpha, mask, native pixel corruption and inset/shadow occlusion checks

provenance_machine_schema.parent_format_contract: Validated against the standardized parent fields, including a fresh commit different from base_commit
